speaker: Doctor
text: I see you've provided no initial symptoms or history yet. To begin our evaluation, can you describe what you notice on your skin, including the size, shape, and color of any spots or lesions?

speaker: Patient
text: 62-year-old male. The patient has recently immigrated to the US from Africa and seeks evaluation for a non-healing, red, crusty lesion on the shaft of his penis and a similar lesion on his left middle finger. Previous treatments in his home country for syphilis and eczema have been unsuccessful. The patient is a smoker, with a history of two packs per day for the last 30 years.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for that detailed history; your heavy smoking history combined with non-healing lesions on the penile shaft and a finger raises concern for squamous cell carcinoma or possibly a rare infection like cutaneous leishmaniasis given your origin. Have these lesions changed in size, shape, or color over the past few months, and have you noticed any bleeding or pain?

REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count, HIV status, and Syphilis Serology (RPR/FTA-ABS).
REQUEST IMAGES: Close-up clinical photographs of the penile and digital lesions.
